page: Microsoft Azure D8plds_v6 is an ARM64-based virtual machine configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores without multithreading, running at 3.4 GHz on the ARM Neoverse-N2 microarchitecture. The instance is provisioned with 16.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU), 128 MB of L3 cache, and a bundled 472 GB NVMe SSD local drive. It operates on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and lacks discrete graphics hardware.

Benchmark results demonstrate reliable mid-tier compute and memory bandwidth, showing 2073.29 on single-core stress-ng, 16574.2 on multi-core stress-ng, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 9344.0. Large-block memory reads achieve 169.64 GB/sec while writes register 72.69 GB/sec. A notable highlight is single-threaded gzip compression at 33.05 GB/sec, placing in the top quartile, whereas cryptographic testing shows lower relative throughput on the PassMark encryption benchmark at 1492.59.

Because of the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this profile reflects a compute-oriented balance rather than a memory-heavy configuration. The integrated high-speed local NVMe storage reduces external block storage overhead for temporary scratch space. Workload suitability centers on scale-out application tiers, Clang-based software compilation, static web serving, containerized services, and lightweight key-value caching.
description: Microsoft Azure D8plds_v6 is an ARM64 instance powered by an 8-core ARM Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz with dedicated physical cores. It features 16.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, alongside 128 MB of L3 cache and a bundled 472 GB local NVMe SSD. Operating on Microsoft Hyper-V without a discrete GPU, the server delivers consistent mid-range performance across synthetic benchmarks, including a multi-core stress-ng score of 16574.2 and strong single-threaded gzip compression throughput of 33.05 GB/sec. While PassMark encryption performance trails at 1492.59, overall throughput remains steady across web serving, software builds, and key-value operations. The inclusion of high-speed local storage coupled with efficient Neoverse cores makes this server suited for code compilation pipelines, web application hosting, caching nodes, and batch compute tasks.
